description:
A support ticket about a printer network connectivity issue was accidentally submitted to the wrong department mailbox. You need to move it to the correct one.

In FreeScout at http://localhost:8080, there is a conversation with the subject "Printer cannot connect to network after office move" currently in the "General Inquiries" mailbox. This ticket is about a network infrastructure problem and should be handled by the IT networking team.

Move this conversation from the "General Inquiries" mailbox to the "IT Network Support" mailbox.

Login credentials:
- Email: admin@helpdesk.local
- Password: Admin123!

After completing the move, the conversation should appear in the "IT Network Support" mailbox and no longer be in "General Inquiries".

metadata.expected_subject: Printer cannot connect to network after office move
